question: The accuracy of measurement by a try square is about:
solution:
The correct answer is __0.002 mm per 10 mm length__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The try square is a tool used for checking the squareness of edges and surfaces.
 
• It is commonly used in woodworking and metalworking.
 
• The accuracy of measurement by a try square depends on its quality and calibration.
 
• For high precision tasks, the accuracy is approximately 0.002 mm per 10 mm length.
 
• Proper maintenance and handling are necessary to preserve its accuracy over time.
